<description>
* "all" is added to the build targets unless GOAL is "all" or contains "codegen". This implicit translation can be confusing, so explicitly spell out the targets as "all", "all deploy", etc., where needed.

* Also, use the eval-based string-to-argv conversion for BUILD_TARGETS to avoid disabling shellcheck SC2086.
</description>

<commits>
fa5643ff99 ci: refactor BUILD_TARGETS use

"all" is added to the build targets unless GOAL is "all" or contains
"codegen". This implicit translation can be confusing, so explicitly
spell out the targets as "all", "all deploy", etc., where needed.

Also, use the eval-based string-to-argv conversion for BUILD_TARGETS to
avoid disabling shellcheck SC2086.
</commits>
